description: This file defines a custom RMI client socket factory that creates SSL-enabled sockets for secure remote method invocation communication. It implements the RMIClientSocketFactory interface and uses SSL utilities from the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SSLClientSocketFactory
classes.description: A factory class implementing RMIClientSocketFactory to create SSL sockets for secure RMI communication.

methods.name: createSocket
methods.description: Creates a new SSL socket connected to the specified host and port, handling security exceptions and logging errors.
